content.value_statement: PDF-to-HTML workflows lose layout context when extraction data is hard to inspect. This skill turns page images and rich text metadata into readable ASCII previews.
actual_capabilities: Reads a PDF page image and rich extraction metadata as inputs.
Produces a text preview that shows page boundaries and content order.
Labels headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, and visual spacing in the preview.
Adds summary statistics about detected page elements and confidence.
Writes the ASCII preview to the expected page artifact path.
limitations: Output quality depends on the accuracy of the source image and extraction metadata.
The skill describes a workflow and does not include executable conversion code.
Complex tables or unusual layouts may need manual review.
Sensitive documents should only be processed under approved privacy controls.

use_cases.title: Review PDF Extraction Quality
use_cases.description: Compare a generated ASCII preview with extraction metadata before creating HTML.

use_cases.title: Prepare HTML Generation Context
use_cases.description: Create a structural text guide that helps an AI generator preserve page hierarchy.

use_cases.title: Debug Layout Differences
use_cases.description: Inspect headings, paragraph flow, lists, and spacing without opening the original PDF page.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Preview
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for one page with standard text flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an ASCII layout preview for this PDF page. Use the page image and rich extraction file. Save the result to the expected artifact path.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Content Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task that checks element coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the ASCII preview and verify that all headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables from the extraction data are represented.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Missing Visual Input
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task when the page image is unavailable.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a text-only ASCII preview from the rich extraction data. Note that the image was unavailable and include confidence limits.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize for HTML Generation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task for downstream AI conversion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a detailed ASCII preview for HTML generation. Emphasize hierarchy, reading order, layout spacing, and any ambiguous structures that need review.

output_examples.input: A textbook PDF page with a chapter heading, two subsections, body paragraphs, and one bullet list.
output_examples.output: A readable preview that marks the page boundary, labels each heading level, shows paragraph flow, and summarizes the list count.

output_examples.input: A PDF page with a table, caption, and several short text blocks.
output_examples.output: A structural preview that aligns table columns, identifies the caption, and reports tables and text blocks in the summary.

output_examples.input: A page image is missing, but rich extraction metadata is available.
output_examples.output: A text-based preview built from extracted spans, with a note that visual spacing confidence is lower.

best_practices: Use both the page image and extraction metadata when available.
Review the ASCII preview before using it for HTML generation.
Keep generated lines short enough for reliable human inspection.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the preview as a pixel-perfect replacement for the page image.
Do not process confidential PDFs without approved data handling controls.
Do not ignore missing or incomplete extraction data before downstream generation.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates a readable ASCII preview that describes PDF page structure and layout.

faq.question: Does it convert PDF pages directly to HTML?
faq.answer: No. It creates a structural preview that can support a later HTML generation step.

faq.question: What inputs are expected?
faq.answer: It expects a page image and a rich extraction file with text spans and metadata.

faq.question: Can it work without a page image?
faq.answer: Yes, it can fall back to text-only analysis, but visual layout confidence is lower.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for teams building AI-assisted PDF conversion and layout review workflows.

faq.question: Is the output final production content?
faq.answer: No. The output is an inspection aid and intermediate artifact for downstream generation.
